description: This file declares the DirectoryLister class and related components for asynchronously listing directory contents in the Chromium project.

classes.name: DirectoryLister
classes.description: Provides an API for asynchronously listing directory contents, with delegate callbacks for each file and completion.

classes.name: DirectoryLister::DirectoryListerData
classes.description: Struct representing a file found during directory listing.

classes.name: DirectoryLister::DirectoryListerDelegate
classes.description: Interface for receiving directory entries and completion notification.

classes.name: DirectoryLister::Core
classes.description: Ref-counted class responsible for retrieving and sorting directory entries on a worker thread.

methods.name: DirectoryLister
methods.description: Constructs a DirectoryLister with specified directory and delegate.
